prompt:
A cinematic, premium food-character poster, vertical 3:4. Use the reference image for the world and the exact character designs: the big round dark iron Chongqing hotpot with glossy red chili oil broth, the warm lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant, and the food characters with googly eyes (white eyeballs, black pupils), small toothless mouths and tiny arms and legs of their own material: cooked fatty beef roll, flat dark velvety tripe sheet, duck blood cube, tofu cube with a cilantro leaf on its head, dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorn clusters, garlic cloves, scallion pieces. Photorealistic textures.

Upper part of the poster: a traditional Chinese restaurant signboard plaque (牌匾), a wide horizontal rectangle of deep red lacquered wood with a carved dark-gold frame border, held up proudly above the hotpot. The CENTER FIELD of the plaque is completely BLANK, smooth flat red lacquer with no text, no characters, no symbols, no decorations — leave it empty. The plaque faces the camera straight-on and flat (no tilt, no perspective distortion), occupying about 85% of the poster width, its blank field roughly in the upper 13%–30% of the poster height. The food characters interact with the plaque: the tripe sheet lies draped over the top edge of the plaque peeking down; the cooked beef roll hangs from the bottom-right corner with both tiny arms, legs swinging, laughing; two dried chilies and a garlic clove stand on the pot rim below holding the plaque up with raised arms like a team lifting it; a peppercorn sits on the top-left corner waving; a scallion piece peeks from behind the left side. Below: the bubbling hotpot full of the other cheering characters (duck blood, tofu with cilantro, chilies, peppercorns) looking up proudly, steam curling around the plaque. Warm lantern light on the lacquer with soft highlights, rich red, amber and gold palette, shallow depth of field, high-end 3D food commercial look, film grain. No text anywhere, no logos, no humans.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
